name: octopus-reef
description: Reef — the governed agentic engineering workspace. An open, evidence-backed alternative to closed agentic IDEs: every agent action is a tamper-evident, replayable, verifiable session.
author: Ran Tao <ran@octopusos.ai>

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/engine packages/protocol packages/driver-claude packages/agent packages/adapter-runtime packages/adapter-observe packages/adapter-blackboard packages/adapter-experience packages/adapter-scout packages/control-plane packages/commercial packages/gateway packages/server packages/cli
scripts.build:ide: npm run build --workspace @octopus-reef/commercial && npm run build --workspace @octopus-reef/ide
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/engine packages/protocol packages/driver-claude packages/agent packages/adapter-runtime packages/adapter-observe packages/adapter-blackboard packages/adapter-experience packages/adapter-scout packages/control-plane packages/commercial packages/gateway packages/server packages/cli
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/engine/tests/*.test.ts packages/driver-claude/tests/*.test.ts packages/agent/tests/*.test.ts packages/adapter-runtime/tests/*.test.ts packages/adapter-observe/tests/*.test.ts packages/adapter-blackboard/tests/*.test.ts packages/adapter-experience/tests/*.test.ts packages/adapter-scout/tests/*.test.ts packages/control-plane/tests/*.test.ts packages/gateway/tests/*.test.ts packages/server/tests/*.test.ts packages/cli/tests/*.test.ts packages/web/tests/*.test.ts packages/ide/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:ide && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run build:ide
